Goal: Open a new sub-account for this member and reach the review (confirmation) screen, then read back the account type and initial deposit shown there. Do not confirm.

Inputs (type the placeholder, not the example value):
- {{inputs.member_id}}: 5-digit member number (example for this run: «inputs.member_id»)
- {{inputs.account_type}}: Sub-account product (example for this run: Holiday Club)
- {{inputs.initial_deposit}}: Opening deposit in USD (example for this run: «inputs.initial_deposit»)

Outputs to extract:
- account_type (string): Account type as shown on the review screen
- initial_deposit (money): Initial deposit as shown on the review screen

outcomes.description: Search ran but no member exists with that member number; flow cannot continue.
App-side validation rejected the member number format (not a valid 5-digit number).
Teller lacks permission to view/service this member (restricted account); cannot open a sub-account.
The sub-account form rejected the account type / initial deposit values, so the review screen is never reached.

input.notes: Flow: Member Inquiry search form -> enter member number -> Search -> member_detail -> 'Open Sub-Account' link -> subacct_form -> select Account Type, fill Initial Deposit (Nickname left blank; not an input for this goal) -> Continue -> subacct_review, where Account Type and Initial Deposit are extracted. The 'Confirm' button on the review screen is deliberately NOT clicked, per the goal, so subacct_opened is never reached. All app content lives in nested iframes (nav frame + content frame). Interstitials seen as possible: member_alert requires a human (call request_help), system_notice/service_unavailable/session_expired/signed_out are handled by the app's state library.
